comparison.objective: Reset tongue-and-groove pliers from the first to the fifth groove; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Open the pliers past their release angle, translate the joint, and close it into a groove versus hex-tool manipulation, fine collar tuning, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers locked in groove five and resting untouched versus two safe dynamic stops with the collar relocked and stable.
comparison.reason: Indexed joint reconfiguration differs from iterative adjustment based on measured energy absorption.
